author: Ashley Bardhan
description:
While the female horror-game protagonist fends off demons and other predators, she is also serving looks. This is the rose-covered cross women are made to bear: We must inspire others with our appearance even while covered in gore. Within the broader scope of patriarchal society, this expectation, which then bleeds into fashionable horror games like Silent Hill 3 and the Fatal Frame series, is unfair. Women actively experiencing horror-game scenarios (a hateful god in Silent Hill 3, homicidal spirits in Fatal Frame, etc.) are already dealing with the stress of needing to do things like craft bullets and practice healthy inventory management. It seems cruel for developers to make them think about how their knee-high socks are rolling down mid-duel, too.

But for women like me, who love horror gam
title: High Stakes, Higher Boots: Here Are Horror Games’ Best-Dressed Women

author: Jessica Cogswell
description:
As both a woman and complete and utter nerd, nothing makes me giddier than when those two core facets of my personality come together in an inspired way. Such is the case of Mooncat's Death Note collaboration, which sees the manga-turned-anime-turned-live-action-film adapted into something a bit different: nail polish.

After a week of teases, the Mooncat x Death Note collection is now live. The collab features nine different polishes, each inspired by a specific character or moment in the dark-yet-beloved series, and marks the first time Death Note has collaborated with a beauty brand.

If like me you are a die-hard Mooncat fan, you already know that their polishes are anything but simple, and this collection is no exception. Th
title: Death Note Is Doing An Unexpected Collab And I’m Already Obsessed

author: Heidi Kemps
description:
Cozy life-sim games where you get to retreat to a rustic village for a relaxing, self-sufficient life on a farmstead are hardly in short supply--and, with so many stellar entries in this genre out there, a game following this formula needs a really good hook to stand out. Village in the Shade, a new release from NIS America on Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC, certainly looks the part of a cheerful, cozy farming game. But, as the phrase goes, looks can be deceiving--and, in this case, that deception runs deep. 

You can tell something is off right from the tutorial, which sees you chasing after an escaped chicken, only to discover something rather distressing. What happens next only leaves you with more questions and some highly unsettling imagery. Somehow, after all this, your player character emerges, stumbling into Kagatsu Village in urgent nee
title: Life-Sim Meets Otherworldly, Encroaching Horror in Village In The Shade

author: Alan Wen
description:
Grand Theft Auto represents the pinnacle of AAA games, not just in huge-scale production values, but in the kind of innovation that rewrites the rules for what games can even be. It seems only Rockstar is capable of fully nailing this style of game. Of course, with its level of success, that hasn't stopped other developers from trying.

Rightly or wrongly, these games are often dubbed GTA clones, a label that automatically assumes it's an inferior imitation to the real McCoy. However, that doesn't mean these games don't have their redeeming features and innovations that offer something different, or in some cases, even arguably improves on GTA's shortcomings--yes, even one of the greatest game series of all time is imperfect.

Even as GTA 6 promises to be the most refined vision of open-world gaming that eclipses all the competition, there's still a good chance you'll find some featur
title: What GTA Clones Did Better Than Grand Theft Auto Itself

author: Claire Lewis
description:
It's been another rough year for video games, with countless studio closures, staff layoffs, and projects that barely managed to even get off the ground before they were unceremoniously cut short. But things are feeling especially grim after EA trotted out two beloved franchises--Mass Effect and Dragon Age--for what amounted to a public execution via the announcement that BioWare has been shuttered. 

This was especially painful for Mass Effect players, who were looking forward to the upcoming Mass Effect 5, which we now know was tentatively titled Mass Effect: Universe. But it's not just BioWare fans who are upset at the moment. Fans of EA's other properties are growing incre
title: EA Just Shelved A Mysterious Sims Project—That Could Be Good News For Players

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Publisher Activision has responded to criticism over using a devastating tragedy in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, saying that the incident will be removed from the military shooter in a November 12 update.

The Seoul Halloween crowd crush occurred in October 2022 in Itaewon. Approximately 100,000 people gathered in a narrow alleyway in Seoul, resulting in 160 casualties as people were suffocated. This year marks the fourth anniversary of the tragedy, with bereaved families and community organizers gathering to remember the lives that were lost.

Modern Warfare 4 hit consoles and PC on October 23, and not long after its release, the game drew criticism from bereaved Korean families. In the opening cutscene to the game's campaign--which focuses on a fictional war between Nor
title: CoD: Modern Warfare To Cut Real-Life Korean Tragedy Segment After Backlash

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
There's a new voice behind the protagonist of Soul in Phantom Blade Zero, and it's none other than Sonic the Hedgehog--or his longtime voice actor, Roger Craig Smith, to be precise.

As spotted by Game Informer, Smith has stepped in to replace Jay Maksenuk (V in Once Human). You can still hear the latter in the various trailers for Phantom Blade Zero, and developer S-Game hasn't revealed why they brought Smith on as a last-minute replacement. Both actors have several video game credits, and as Game Informer noted, it sounds like Masenuk was replaced shortly after the game's review period began. Essentially, you won't be hearing Masenuk's voice, as the game laun
title: Phantom Blade Zero’s Lead Voice Actor Was Seemingly Replaced At The Last Minute

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
If you thought there wasn't going to be a new Assassin's Creed game this year, think again. It's not a video game, but Assassin's Creed: Animus is out today, turning the series into an adventure-style board game for 1-4 players.

A competitive game that pits players against each other as they explore distinct eras from the video games, Assassin's Creed: Animus features four protagonists to choose from in its standard edition: Eivor, Ezio, Altair, and Connor. The Collector's Edition, meanwhile, expands to 10 eras and features 16 protagonists, adding game characters like Edward Kenway, Jacob and Evie Frye, and Kassandra.

You and up to three of your friends (
title: New Assassin’s Creed Game Is Out Now, If You Don’t Mind Being Board

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's inaugural season arrives on November 6, bringing a brand-new battle pass and more weapons to unlock. Season 1 also integrates Modern Warfare 4's content into Warzone, so you'll be able to unlock and use these weapons in battle royale as well. In this guide, we'll detail all of Modern Warfare 4's new Season 1 weapons and how you can unlock them for free.

As for new content, Season 1 of Modern Warfare 4 includes new maps and game modes for multiplayer. DMZ is getting a new map, more DMZ Orders, and additional FOB upgrades. Warzone is transitioning to Modern Warfare 4 content, meaning it will remove Black Ops 7's omnimovement and add two Modern Warfare-themed maps. Modern Warfare 4 weapons and operators will also integrate with the big update.
title: How To Unlock All Season 1 Weapons In Modern Warfare 4 And Warzone

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
EA recently announced it was shutting down BioWare, ending a studio responsible for multiple hit games over 30 years. According to a new report, EA's decision was driven by economics, as it had to choose between funding a new Mass Effect and backing the safer bet, Star Wars: Battlefront 3.

Bloomberg's Jason Schreier reported that EA had to choose between two costly projects, and with the added pressure of paying off $18 billion in leveraged debt after its sale to a business consortium and Saudi Arabia's investment fund, Battlefront 3 made more fina
title: EA Reportedly Chose An Unannounced Star Wars Game Over BioWare’s Next Mass Effect

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
What's the coolest moment in any Mission: Impossible movie? For many, watching Tom Cruise extend his winning streak of cheating death with a risky stunt is a heck of a highlight, but I've always loved that last-minute plot twist born of silicon masks and uncanny impersonations. What if you could turn that highly specific part of the Mission: Impossible franchise into a video game? Then you'd get Legion Was Here, a stylish deductive game that is pushing my ability to recall small details to its breaking point.

The premise is simple: As the super-spy Legion, you have to don an accurate disguise and learn everything there is to know about your new identity and target through a detailed dossier. Meet your mark, engage in banter, and try to avoid making any slip-ups, lest you want your chat to end with a few bullets in your back. It's the opposite of a game like 007 First Light, where espionage involves a button press and t
title: This Stylish Spy Game Gets What Makes Mission: Impossible So Great

author: Jake Dekker
description:
Only a few more weeks remain before Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and while Rockstar Games recently lifted the lid on its big open-world sequel, that's still not enough. There's definitely value in approaching a game with as little knowledge as possible so that you can enjoy any potential surprises, but we're not those people.

Instead, senior video producer Jake Dekker decided to grab a folder of high-resolution GTA 6 screenshots--a whole 99 of them, not including the promotional images for GTA 6's Ultimate Edition--and analyzed dozens of them for hidden details. Here's what he found in the first part of his JPEG investigations.
title: GTA 6’s Attention To Detail Is Getting A Little Ridiculous

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you eager to complete The Herald’s Illusion in Phantom Blade Zero? This quest might be optional, but it’s important if you want to discover more secrets in the game. It also takes you to strange realms hidden in select regions. Our guide discusses everything you need to know about this mission, though we’ve also added a few minor spoilers.

In This Article
  • What does The Herald’s Illu
title: How To Complete The Herald’s Illusion Quest In Phantom Blade Zero

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Destiny's future lies in its past, as Bungie is working to bring content from the infamous Destiny vault back to the game. Big plans are in place to rework fan-favorite campaigns like the Red War and Forsaken back into Destiny 2, and while that content won't be out for quite a while, Bungie has also detailed what you should not expect from the studio as the year winds down. Long story short: Don't expect to see Destiny 3 teased at The Game Awards.

"Knowing we are early in incubating our future and actively working on projects to bridge us to that new home, don't expect us to make a Destiny announcement at the TGAs this year, or to randomly drop a logo that sets the
title: Don’t Expect Destiny 3 At The Game Awards, Bungie Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The first trailer for the Death Stranding anime spin-off, Death Stranding: Isolations, has dropped, revealing a quick and spooky glimpse at a world that has been ravaged by several extinction events. The brief teaser reveals little, and amusingly, the official synopsis simply reads, "My mom became a crater." But if you are a fan of Hideo Kojima's post-apocalyptic world and setting? There's plenty to glean from this footage through the visuals, and the trailer also reveals the talent behind this project.

If you're unfamiliar with the games, Death Stranding takes place in a world where humanity has been brought to the brink of extinction. After Beached Things (BTs) began to roam the land, various cataclysms br
title: “My Mom Became A Crater” Is A Very Death Stranding Way To Start An Anime

author: Phil Owen
description:
One Piece is taking over Fortnite for the next month as part of the game's now-annual November mini-season, which swaps out the current Battle Royale island for a smaller new pirate-themed one. Dubbed Fortnite Treasure Hunters, the new season starts November 1 and will also focus heavily on music collabs with A$AP Rocky, Lil Uzi Vert, Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto--Epic isn't putting all its eggs in one cartoon basket like it did last year with its Simpsons season.

Epic started doing these mini-seasons back in Chapter 4 with the original Fortnite OG event, and that one went so well that the company decided to make it a tradition. With Fortnite facing down the launch of GTA VI in late November, it needed some serious firepower--and One Piece, which has been one of the most requested Fortnite collabs ever, certainly qualifies.
title: Everything New In Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini-Season

author: Callum Self
description:
If I had a nickel for every time an ’80s British horror movie got turned into a successful and faithful horror game almost four decades later, I wouldn’t have a lot of nickels. In fact, I’d probably have only one—thanks to Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival. It’s gross, brutal, and as horrific as you’ve come to expect from the franchise, but you don’t need to know Hellraiser to enjoy it. In fact, going in blind is an interesting experience, and right now, you can get a huge discount on it for a limited time.

You play as Aidan, who chases extreme situations during the “fun” times with his girlfriend, as the pair accidentally summon the demonic Cenobites thanks to the familiar Genesis Configuration. (If I had a nickel for every time that happened to me… I wouldn’t have any.) After being knocked unconscious and becoming a captive of th
title: Hellraiser: Revival Is A Brutal, Gory Gift You Should Get Yourself This Halloween

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Are you scouring the Wulin in search of the Three-Faced Puppet in Phantom Blade Zero? This foe might be one of the toughest that you face early in the campaign. If you achieve victory, you're bound to wonder where your quarry went. Our guide discusses everything you need to know about this opponent and the Triple Threat quest. That said, bear in mind that there will be spoilers ahead.
